summary: Memory contract for the build.sh launcher: durable state remains existing repository/dependency artifacts and AppForge runtime files; launcher mode and child-process ownership stay process-local; no new secret or user preference store is introduced.

memory_surfaces.scope: Process-local arguments and APPFORGE_* environment variables.
memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: Command-line arguments and environment at invocation time.
memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: Process exit or rerun with different arguments/environment.

memory_surfaces.lifetime: Persists across local runs until dependencies are changed or the user removes .venv.
memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: pyproject.toml, uv.lock, and the installed .venv/bin/appforge executable.
memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: pyproject.toml or uv.lock changes, missing .venv/bin/appforge, failed uv/pip sync, or explicit APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL not being set.

memory_surfaces.lifetime: Tracked source artifact refreshed by npm --prefix frontend run build.
memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: frontend/package-lock.json, frontend/package.json, frontend/src, frontend/public, and Vite build output under appforge/resources/web.
memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: Frontend source/package changes or a failed/missing production build.

memory_surfaces.scope: APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL health response and .appforge-web/llm-bridge.log for launcher-owned bridge starts.
memory_surfaces.lifetime: Health is live process state; logs persist as ignored runtime files until user cleanup.
memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: Bridge /health endpoint and launcher-captured bridge PID.
memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: Bridge process exit, changed bridge URL, failed health probe, or launcher cleanup.

memory_surfaces.scope: appforge web process, .appforge-web runtime directory, and existing AppForge web job snapshots after UI use.
memory_surfaces.lifetime: Foreground server lifetime for process state; existing .appforge-web state persists per web app behavior.
memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: appforge.web/web_jobs runtime behavior and launcher-captured web PID in smoke mode.
memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: Server process exit, app restart conversion of in-flight jobs, or user cleanup of .appforge-web.

memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: HTTP status results collected by the launcher within APPFORGE_SMOKE_TIMEOUT.

memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: Behavioral changes to build.sh or appforge web startup.

state_ownership.state: Invocation mode, host, port, and skip flags
readers: build.sh setup, launch, smoke, and help branches

writers: python3 -m venv and pip install fallback

state_ownership.state: Provider secrets and active provider settings
writers: Existing provider settings UI or environment variables

retention: build.sh introduces no new durable preference or secret store. .venv, frontend/node_modules, llm_bridge/node_modules, and .appforge-web runtime files retain existing local-workspace lifetimes. Packaged web assets and documentation are tracked source files. Process-local mode, smoke, and PID memory vanish on exit.
serialization: Launcher configuration is serialized only as shell variables. Durable artifacts use existing file formats: pyproject.toml/uv.lock/package-lock.json for dependency state, Vite output files under appforge/resources/web, .appforge-web JSON/log files owned by existing web/bridge systems, and Markdown docs.
privacy: build.sh must not read, print, persist, or transform provider API keys.
Environment variables pass through to existing appforge/bridge code without logging their values.
.env and .env.* remain ignored by existing .gitignore policy.
Bridge logs should capture service startup output but not receive secrets from the launcher.
reconciliation: Each run reconciles state from source of truth rather than trusting hidden caches: Python readiness checks .venv/bin/appforge after optional install, frontend readiness depends on npm build unless explicitly skipped, bridge readiness uses live health, smoke readiness uses live HTTP probes, and docs are validated by review/diff.
observability: Launcher terminal output names each major step and the final URL.
Smoke mode prints probe progress and success/failure.
Bridge startup writes .appforge-web/llm-bridge.log only when the launcher owns that process.
Verification commands record bash syntax, smoke, pytest, typecheck, and build results.

tests.name: process-local-smoke-memory
tests.evidence: ./build.sh --smoke must start, probe, and cleanup launcher-owned PIDs without persisting a launcher config file.

tests.name: dependency-state-reconciliation
tests.evidence: APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 smoke reuses current .venv/assets, while normal mode runs configured sync/build paths.

tests.name: source-doc-memory
tests.evidence: README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md contain the launcher path and options.

tests.name: secret-exclusion
tests.evidence: Security review checks build.sh and docs for no committed or echoed provider secrets.
